record.question: The following persons may be charged and tried together, namely: — (A) persons accused of the same offence committed in the course of the same transaction; (B) persons accused of an offence and persons accused of abetment of, or attempt to commit, such offence; (C) persons accused of more than one offence of the same kind, within the meaning of section 242 committed by them jointly within the period of twelve months; (D) persons accused of different offences committed in the course of the same transaction;
options: A, B, C & D are correct
